name: Find the Stickmen (101)
desc:
Welcome to Find the Stickmen!

In this game you search the map and travel across various areas and realms in order to collect all the stickmen! Complete obbies and solve puzzles to find every stickman.

While most stickmen are relatively simple to find, some require much more patience and skill in order to find. This game is inspired by many "Find the" games especially find the reggies.

Thank you to MrMuffinIsCool for motivating me and making a lot of the beginning images for stickmen.
